scope: Freshly written, not pulled from Gamma. Problems with no authored JS/Python pair in clocksmith/gamma catalogue/authored at head dd7dd823, verified by the parent before delivery, no overlaps found. Only 8 problems in IDs 2801-2950 meet the simple-input constraints; 110 in range already authored, rest are JS-only, pandas, or unverified. This is not a claim of Gamma official independent admission.
qualification_method: For each problem: public examples in both languages, plus 20 random cross-language agreement checks per problem (JS via node, Python via import, outputs compared), plus 20/20 agreement with an independent brute-force reference in Python on the same random cases (BFS over states for 2808, enumeration for the others). Float tolerance 1e-6 not needed; all outputs are integers.
